negative_snippets:
I stayed here for three days and it was a regrettable choice. The online photos showed rooms with balconies, but the actual rooms did not. This set the tone for what turned out to be a very poor stay.

My first room had cockroaches all around the space. I complained right away. The manager insisted that pest control had been done, yet nothing changed. On the third day, I was shifted to another room that was claimed to be clean. That room also had cockroaches, which made it clear that hygiene is not taken seriously.

The food was mediocre. There is no in-house kitchen and the breakfast they serve is brought in from outside. The quality reflects that.

The manager’s behavior was notably abrasive and dismissive. It added an unnecessary layer of irritation to an already unpleasant stay.

There are far better hotels in the same lane. I would not recommend this place to anyone, whether someone from my own circle or someone reading this review. Save yourself the trouble and choose a better option nearby.

Rooms are not so clean, has lot of roaches. They dont have any in house restaurant so the breakfast provided is not great and doesn't have much options. I may not want to come back here for long stays.
